mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, LINK_URL) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{memberId}, #{notiType}, #{content}, #{linkUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (NOTIFICATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, LINK_URL) SELECT SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, MEMBER_ID, #{notiType}, #{content}, #{linkUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, READ_YN, CREATED_AT FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY NOTIFICATION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y', READ_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND READ_YN = 'N'
